_description: Self-made positive fixture 1: a genuinely Pell-consistent (a,p,f6,C) quintuple constructed by (i) choosing a with rootpart [2,2,1] directly (double roots at x=-4,-2, simple root at x=-3), (ii) defining p := a'/d rescaled to a5 (T-2 holds by construction, d=gcd(a,a')), (iii) scanning small integer root triples until a^2 mod p^2 came out to be an honest nonzero constant (Pell/E-4). All of E-1..E-6 and T-1/T-2 are expected to PASS (checker returns stage=null).
